sngl generate --out out site.sngl
exists out/one.html
exists out/two.html
exists out/index.html

-- site.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import "sngl:platform/html"

output { none { html } }

struct Item {
    slug string = ""
    title string = ""
}

const items list<Item> = [
    {slug="one", title="One"},
    {slug="two", title="Two"},
]

component main {
    for it = items {
        window #page(title=it.title, href="/" + it.slug + ".html") {
            text(value=it.title)
        }
    }
    window #index(title="Index", href="/index.html") {
        for p = page {
            html.a(href=p.href, innerText=p.title)
        }
    }
}
